name: lal-uat-05-recon-cfs-rebuild
description: Rebuilds the latest published CFS recon snapshots (settle, actual, traders) on UAT after the latest_active_lot fill of 19 Nov 16:05. The builders read latest_active_lot when they run, so snapshots built before the fill miss the 1,177,828 CFS trades that were absent. Same run id and settlement date, pointer untouched, same advisory lock as the app refresh. A snapshot that already contains trades the fill added (cache minus backup parity_work.change_lal_uat_02_fill_fill_all_bus_20261119160510) is skipped, so a second run does nothing. No backup: derived rows, deleted and rebuilt by run id. Settle takes about 10 to 15 minutes for CFS; steps with no published snapshot skip with a message. Run with --session statement_timeout=0 --session synchronous_commit=off --session work_mem=256MB --session maintenance_work_mem=1GB. Then lal-uat-04-recon-cfs-check.xml and recon-refresh-cfs-verify-uat.xml run.
